summary: Per-farm auto-return time (Własna Godzina Powrotu). Backend: 14/14 pytest pass: default 00:00; PUT 06:30 persists and shows in GET /api/devices auto_return for kowalski-a while Marco Polo stays 00:00; PUT '' disables; 25:00/6:30/12:60/abc/06:30:00/' 06:30' -> 422; superadmin with no client_id -> 422; client admin sets own farm, and a client_id pointing at another farm is ignored (own farm is updated, Marco Polo unchanged); operator/viewer -> 403; unauthenticated -> 401. REAL scheduler run: set Kowalski to the next Warsaw minute and put kowalski-a ch1 and chlodnia-01 ch1 in manual. kowalski-a returned to auto and the event 'automatyczny powrót do AUTO (HH:MM)' was logged. Marco Polo stayed manual and was then set back to auto. Frontend at 390x844: auto-return-card shows for superadmin with Kowalski selected and the farm name in its title; save gives toast 'Zapisano'; the chamber hint shows 'Powrót do AUTO o 05:45' in manual and updates after a save or page reload (07:00); the time input is disabled when the checkbox is off; when disabled there is no hint in manual; the hint is hidden in auto mode. State restored: both farms 00:00, all chambers auto, test users deleted.

issues: The time input is 120px wide. In browsers with a 12h locale (headless en-US) it shows '05:45 AM' and the leading digit is clipped. Polish locale uses 24h, so the impact is low; consider width ~140px or minWidth

action_items: Optional: widen the auto-return-time input to avoid clipping in 12h locales
critical_code_review_comments: midnight_auto sleeps until about second 2 of each minute and checks only the current HH:MM. If the loop stalls for more than 60s, or the backend restarts during the target minute, that day's return is silently skipped. No catch-up exists (acceptable for MVP).
A client admin passing another farm's client_id gets 200 and updates their own farm. This is safe but silent; 403 might be clearer.
reset_manual_to_auto logs an event only when publish_command succeeds, so offline devices are not logged. A failed publish is never retried later that day.
seed_data_creation: Temporary test_<tag>_{admin,operator,viewer}@kowalski.pl users were created and deleted by the fixture
context_for_next_testing_agent: Landing page requires clicking welcome-login-button before the login form. Superadmin selects a device with device-select (value=device_id). The scheduler test takes about 60-120s. Event message text is in events[].message. Restore auto_return to 00:00 for both clients after tests.
